what: Fix compilation, remove duplicate graph traversal code, and refactor secrets redaction
why: mcp.go failed to build due to obsolete type references and duplication of graph traversal logic. Also, database connection strings and key-value assignments were mangled due to a generic redaction replacement.
learned: Never duplicate core BFS/ShortestPath logic in MCP tool definitions; reuse graph package. Struct-based regex-to-template map avoids incorrect substitutions in secrets redaction.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
impact: All unit tests build and pass cleanly. Sanitization outputs are no longer mangled and are fully validated by tests.
errors_faced: Mangled DB connection string and assignment separators during redaction; undefined references in mcp.go.
next_steps: Await user instructions for next improvements.
